invariants: All tenant_scoped tables require ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY before product use.
Runtime role is not owner, superuser, or BYPASSRLS; no DDL and no DELETE grants.
Every tenant-scoped query uses both RLS and an explicit server-derived tenant predicate.
Global catalogues are SELECT-only for ordinary app role.
Control-plane tables have no ordinary app-role grants; operation-specific grants require a named command, service identity, and audit behavior.

The rls_current and current_rls_enabled_and_forced fields preserve the pre-REM-WP1.5 through-0012 baseline (three tenant tables had ENABLE+FORCE at that snapshot). Migration 0013 and the complete effective policy/grant matrix were verified under restricted CI roles in run 43683206104; see the REM-WP1.5 candidate evidence record.

operation_specific_capabilities.name: symphony.enqueue_command_outbox_message(uuid, uuid)
operation_specific_capabilities.implementation: SECURITY DEFINER function owned by dedicated NOLOGIN role symphony_outbox_writer (not the schema/migration owner); fixed safe search_path; fully qualified objects; parameterized IDs; PUBLIC EXECUTE revoked; EXECUTE granted only to symphony_app; forced-RLS INSERT policy TO symphony_outbox_writer permits only a pending row referencing a domain_events row whose tenant equals transaction-local app.tenant_id. Capability role has no memberships, no SET ROLE path, no login or table ownership; its only privileges are schema USAGE, INSERT on event_outbox and SELECT on domain_events.
